reconstruction_gate.criterion: semantic action-target-intent-constraints equivalence to original English

attack_methods_compared.multilingual_translation_baseline: translated_direct_<lang> (Yong et al. 2023 low-resource style); official translations, no re-translation
attack_methods_compared.csrt_codeswitch_baseline: csrt_k{1,2,3}, csrt_all (Yoo et al. 2024); intra-sentential code-switch on official spans, direct submission
attack_methods_compared.ours_slot: slot_k{1,2,3}; inline lexical-tile reconstruction game (same spans as csrt_k, with game framing)
attack_methods_compared.ablation_nogame: nogame_<ordering>_n{k}; interleave fragments without game framing (MIDAS w/o Game-Style)
attack_methods_compared.csrt_codeswitch_baseline_mt: csrt_mt_n{2,3} (Yoo et al. 2024, faithful full-coverage): NLLB-200 segment translation, whole-sentence intra-sentential code-switch; MACHINE-TRANSLATED baseline only, never used by our method

matched_comparison: slot_k{k} vs csrt_k{k} use the SAME official spans and items; the only difference is the reconstruction-game framing, isolating our contribution over plain multilingual code-switching
statistics: Wilson 95% CI per condition; paired bootstrap 95% CI + exact McNemar for every ours-vs-baseline contrast on common items
data_policy: raw harmful prompts/completions/judge transcripts under private_artifacts/* at 0600; only aggregate summaries committed

split_discipline.purpose: isolate hyper-parameter selection from final reporting; NO model training
split_discipline.dev: used only to pick best language load n / slot k / defense prompt
split_discipline.test: held-out; every main comparison table is reported on test

target_note: jailbreak lift scales with target alignment strength; Mistral (english_direct gated ~0.69) is a weakly-aligned control showing the method needs a refusal barrier to bypass, vs aligned targets (Qwen2.5-7B english ~0.25)
